label: Getting started
description: Install Myne, create your first encrypted vault, save your recovery phrase, and write your first note.

label: Notes & organization
description: Organize your vault with folders and folder notes, favorites, trash and archive, multi-select actions, tabs, split view and named workspaces, templates, and daily notes.

label: Editor & writing
description: Write in the editor with view modes, focus mode, folding, multiple cursors, find and replace, slash commands, comments, spell check, display settings, saved views, and note export.

label: Markdown
description: The markdown Myne renders, from basics and tables to code blocks, math, diagrams, callouts, and frontmatter.

label: Find & connect
description: Locate and relate notes with wikilinks, backlinks, unlinked mentions, tags, search, and the graph view.

label: Attachments & import
description: Attach files and record voice notes, manage them in the attachments library, and import an existing Obsidian vault.

label: Safety & recovery
description: Recover a forgotten password, back up and restore your vault, use note snapshots, and manage multiple vaults.

label: Settings & privacy
description: Adjust appearance and keyboard shortcuts, set up quick unlock and auto-lock, protect against screen capture, change your password, and understand the privacy model.
